blocks.html: Robinsons Galleria South in San Pedro, Laguna will be home to more than (200) Bonsai plants and Suiseki stones as it hosts the 2022 BSAPI (Bonsai and Suiseki Alliance of the Philippines, Inc.) National Bonsai and Suiseki Exhibit and Competition. Bonsai, the art of cultivating miniature plants and Suiseki– better known as the art of stone appreciation have been gaining the patronage and interest of Filipinos nationwide with its unique take on beauty, grace and power to evoke the greatness of nature. The specimens are sourced from various provinces in the country and will be displayed from June 10 – 16, 2022.

Six industry experts will determine the best entries and will be awarding the winners on June 11, 10:30AM, while horticulturist and enthusiast can take part in a series of workshops, lectures and demo to be conducted on June 11 to 15, 1 pm to 4 pm.
